faqs.a:
All municipal judges shall strictly comply with the canons of judicial ethics as set
               forth as Appendix to
chapter 70
, the Colorado Rules of Judicial Discipline as amended from time-to-time. Notwithstanding
               the preceding, city council has jurisdiction over the conduct of Arvada municipal
               judges pursuant to Rule 4 of the Colorado Rules of Judicial Discipline and the Charter
               and shall have the authority to enforce the canons of judicial ethics and may discipline
               any municipal judge who is deemed by the city council to have violated those canons.
               Nothing herein shall otherwise serve as a limitation on city council's right to terminate
               employment of any municipal judge in accordance with the Charter.
(Code 1981, § 18-45; Ord. No. 3676, § 1, 1-22-2001)
